pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Yugoslav Attack
pages.notes: Plan 3 had a Qe1-h4 route for a queen on d2; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8 and ...Rxc3. Rewrote plans 2 and 3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Yugoslav Attack, Modern Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 had sacrifices Bxh7+ (no bishop can reach h7) and Nxg6 (no knight can reach g6) and an h4-h5-hxg6 route; plan 2 called the half-open c-file open and had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Yugoslav Attack, Panov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Kb1 before White has castled; plan 4 had ...Bxc3 through the f6-knight; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote plans 2-4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 7.f3 O-O 8.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.g4 Be6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.g4 Nxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White attack with the e3-bishop that must recapture on d4; plan 2 had ...Rxc3. Rewrote plans 1 and 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O Bd7 10.g4
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3; plan 3 had Qh2 with the h-pawn still on h2; plan 4 suggested trading the d7-bishop for a knight, which the reviewer could not confirm. Rewrote plans 2-4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O d5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 shattering White's kingside and missed that 9...d5 is a pawn sacrifice (10.exd5 Nxd5 11.Nxc6 bxc6) for the b-file and the long diagonal. Rewrote plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O d5 10.exd5
pages.notes: Plan 3 pressed a d6-pawn that is no longer there; plans 2 and 4 had c-file play and ...Rxc3, though after 11.Nxc6 bxc6 the c-file is closed and Black's play is on the b-file and long diagonal. Rewrote plans 2-4.
